title: Identity & Belonging
intro: Somewhere between six and twelve, a child starts asking a new question: am I any good, and do I belong here? School answers it in marks and teams and who sat with them at lunch. This month we answer it differently, and we answer it out loud — you are known, you were made on purpose, and your place with us was never in doubt.

keyScriptures.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb. I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
I have called you by name; you are mine.

weeks.title: You Are Known
weeks.declaration: You are known by name and made on purpose. Nothing about you was left to chance, and nobody who made you was guessing. This week we settle it: you are known, and you are wonderfully made.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for knowing our child completely and loving them anyway. Where the world would measure them, help us to call out who they already are. Amen.

weeks.title: You Belong
weeks.declaration: You belong here — in this family, in God's family, at this table. Belonging is not something you have to keep winning. It was given, and it is yours.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make our home a place where belonging is never in question. Let our child feel safe here before they feel impressive anywhere else. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are Held
weeks.declaration: You are seen, precious and held. When you are small in a big room, when nobody claps, when you get it wrong — you are still held by hands that do not get tired.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, hold what we cannot hold. When our child is out of our sight, be nearer to them than we could be. Amen.

weeks.title: You Are His
weeks.declaration: You are His, and that is the deepest true thing about you. Whatever else changes this year, that does not.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, root this child in You so deeply that no season shakes it. Let them grow up knowing whose they are. Amen.

days.title: Known by Name
days.declaration: You are known by name. Not just counted, not just noticed — known. The God who made the stars knows what makes you laugh and what makes you go quiet.

scripture.text: I have called you by name; you are mine.

days.title: Made on Purpose
days.declaration: You were made on purpose, and God does not make things by accident. Every part of how you were put together was chosen.

scripture.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb.

days.title: Wonderfully Made
days.declaration: You are wonderfully made. Not almost right, not nearly enough — wonderfully made, and God does beautiful work.

scripture.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: You Belong Here
days.declaration: You belong here. In this family, in this home, at this table. Your place was not given out by mistake and nobody can take it.

scripture.text: You are no longer strangers, but members of God's household.

days.title: A Child of God
days.declaration: You are a child of God. That is not something you earned today or could lose tomorrow. It is who you are.

scripture.text: To all who received him, he gave the right to become children of God.

days.title: Chosen
days.declaration: You are chosen. Before you could do anything impressive, you were already picked, already wanted, already loved.

scripture.text: He chose us in him before the creation of the world.

days.title: God Delights in You
days.declaration: God is not merely putting up with you. He delights in you. He is glad you are here.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you.

days.title: Not What You Do
days.declaration: You are not what you do. Your worth is not your marks, your goals scored, or how fast you finish. You are loved before you begin.

scripture.text: The Lord looks at the heart.

days.title: Loved on Hard Days
days.declaration: You are loved on your hard days exactly as much as on your best ones. Love does not go up and down with your behaviour.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Made in His Image
days.declaration: You were made in God's image. When people meet you, something of Him shows. That is a wonderful thing to carry.

scripture.text: So God created mankind in his own image.

days.title: You Are Seen
days.declaration: You are seen. Even when nobody claps, even when nobody notices — you are seen by the One who matters most.

scripture.text: You are the God who sees me.

days.title: Held
days.declaration: You are held. When you feel wobbly, there are hands under you that do not get tired.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand.

days.title: Precious
days.declaration: You are precious and honoured. Not because of what you can give anyone, but simply because you are His.

scripture.text: You are precious and honoured in my sight, and I love you.

days.title: A Good Work
days.declaration: You are God's handiwork — something good that He is still making. He has not put down His tools.

scripture.text: We are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

days.title: You Fit
days.declaration: You fit. You do not have to shrink or stretch to belong here. You were measured for this family exactly as you are.

scripture.text: Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it.

days.title: Adopted In
days.declaration: You have been brought in and kept. You are not a visitor in God's family, waiting to be asked to leave.

scripture.text: He predestined us for adoption to sonship.

days.title: Written Down
days.declaration: Your days were written down before one of them happened. Nothing about your life has caught God out.

scripture.text: All the days ordained for me were written in your book.

days.title: Never Forgotten
days.declaration: You are never forgotten. Even if the whole world got busy and looked away, God would not.

scripture.text: I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.

days.title: Enough
days.declaration: You are enough. You do not have to be the best at everything to be worth loving. You already are.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you.

days.title: Different on Purpose
days.declaration: The ways you are different were not mistakes. They were chosen, and they are needed.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts in the body just as he wanted them.

days.title: You Are His
days.declaration: You are His. Whoever else you belong with, you belong to God first, and that never changes.

scripture.text: We are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

days.title: Numbered
days.declaration: Even the hairs on your head are numbered. God pays attention to the smallest thing about you.

scripture.text: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

days.title: A Little Lower Than Angels
days.declaration: You were crowned with glory and honour. That is how highly God thinks of you.

scripture.text: You have crowned them with glory and honour.

days.title: Safe to Be Yourself
days.declaration: With God you are safe to be exactly yourself. Nothing about you needs to be hidden to be loved.

scripture.text: You have searched me, Lord, and you know me.

days.title: Called Friend
days.declaration: God calls you a friend. Not a servant, not a stranger — a friend He wants to tell things to.

scripture.text: I have called you friends.

days.title: Held Together
days.declaration: When things feel like they are coming apart, you are held together. He is the one doing the holding.

scripture.text: In him all things hold together.

days.title: You Are Wanted
days.declaration: You are wanted. Being here is not an inconvenience to anyone. We are glad you came.

scripture.text: How precious to me are your thoughts, God!

days.title: Family
days.declaration: You have a family in God that reaches further than this house. You will never run out of people to belong to.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Loved First
days.declaration: You did not have to earn this love by loving well. God loved you first, and He started it.

scripture.text: We love because he first loved us.

days.title: A New Name
days.declaration: God has a name for you that is better than any name anyone else has called you.

scripture.text: I will give him a white stone with a new name written on it.

days.title: Yours to Keep
days.declaration: Everything said over you this month is true tomorrow too. Nobody can take it back, and you can carry it all year.

scripture.text: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!
